comparison.objective: Smooth a cake side while one arm holds a scraper and the other turns a turntable.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual steady tool contact and continuous turntable rotation against deformable food.
comparison.success_condition: Achieve a smoothed cake side through coordinated scraping; numeric and damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both use bimanual stabilization and rotation, this tests continuous surface finishing, not hex-key engagement, retained-collar adjustment, lock integrity, or dynamic stopping behavior.
